jasmin: Heads-up: found a subtle parity bug in JSON mode during tool/fncall retries. Node helper coerces top-level array -> object in some retries, which breaks union schemas. Repro attached.
jasmin: Steps: callTool(..., jsonMode: true) where the tool normally returns top-level array. Transient 401 causes retry; helper reassembles and emits a single object (first element) instead of array. Schema is typed as array | object (union) and validator picks the wrong branch.
rui: Interesting. So sometimes we lose the original shape metadata?
jasmin: Exactly. The helper assembly path drops a "raw-shape" flag when replaying buffered frames. Python keeps a shape tag in the envelope and parity tests missed it.
kevin: Can you paste the minimal failing log?
jasmin: Log: 
```
transport: frame1 = [{"id":1}]
retry: auth refresh -> replay frame1
assembly: collapsed -> {"id":1}
validator: union mismatch -> chose OBJECT branch, downstream code expects ARRAY
```
rui: Two mitigations: 1) preserve an envelope header like "__redwood_raw_shape":"array" across retries, or 2) make validator attempt both branches more permissively for union schemas. Option 1 is less surprising to apps.
kevin: Agree. Also add a strictJsonMode flag that enforces no coercion (fail loudly) so onboarding samples surface the issue instead of hiding it.
jasmin: I'll open a PR to 1) preserve raw_shape in assembly, 2) add a short-term collapse-safety fallback for single-element arrays only when expectedType==object and strictJsonMode===false, and 3) add unit parity tests (node vs py) using recorded frame replays.
devex-bot: Created ticket DX-3301: "preserve raw shape across tool retries to avoid union coercion". Labels: dx, sdk-parity, jsonmode.
ops-bot: Note: flagged customer onboard runs that hit this; support ticket 9423 linked.
jasmin: Attaching tiny repro and suggested test harness to DX-3301. Thanks all :thumbsup:
